title: monitors
description: Vision v2 (only to a server that lists `vision_binary`): the PC's screens, sent on the Vision channel when the stream starts and after a display change. The server checks the list (1 to 16 screens, unique `index`, sizes 1 to 65535) and drops it otherwise, keeps the last one for the open tunnel and forwards it, under the tunnel's device ID, only to the panels of the admins holding a session for the device.

list.description: One entry per screen, in Windows order.

index.description: Screen number: the value for select_monitor and the monitor byte of the frames of this screen. Unique in the list.

primary.description: The Windows primary screen, streamed until the viewer selects another. Missing means false.
